Name: A House in the Calico Desert
Author: hoshikuzunosora
Description:
Want a place to sleep for the night after spending all day spelunking in the skull caverns? Or do you just want a little home away from home within the Calico Desert? Whether it be for aesthetic or functional purposes, this quaint little house has something for everyone!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Minor Update: since mobile has updated to 1.6, i've archived the 1.5 versions of the mod. If you need the 1.5 versions for whatever reason please ask for them. Thank you!

[color=#e69138]1.0.1 Update:[/color]

Vanilla:
-Adds a couple of cacti in between where you can walk into the bath to better visualize where you walk into the bath
-Adds update keys for in case I update the mod again in the future

SVE:
-Adjusts the warps to be more compatible with other desert mods
-Adds a path underneath the bus to visualize where the warp is
-Adds a couple of cacti in between where you can walk into bath to better visualize where you walk into the bath

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[color=#e69138]Features include:[/color]

- A front yard with a small spot for desert forageables to spawn, along with a fully functioning mailbox

- A spacious house with a kitchen, spa, and bed to sleep in. Decorate (mostly, see below) to your hearts content, or use the space for more kegs or furnaces!

-A cellar that's accessible through both the kitchen and the yard for aging wine in casks

-A backyard with a huge fishable pool! Crops and trees grow year-round, and sprinklers work in the sand. There are designated places for crops, but you can plant anywhere you desire.

-Everything used is vanilla. so recolor mods should be compatible with it!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[color=#e69138]Known Issues:[/color]

Despite my best efforts, I was unable to make both the walls and floors fully functional. Any furniture piece that can be placed on the floor (Tables, TVs, Chairs, ETC) works just fine, but you will be unable to place wall decorations or change the wallpaper and flooring in the house. I'm hoping to change this in the future once I become more experienced with modding.

[s]As of now, this mod is incompatible with SVE (or any other mod that expands the desert for that matter) due to warps, but I'm in the process of creating an SVE version that should be done very soon. Please hang tight! If there are any other mods that I need to adjust for, please do let me know! 
[/s][b]EDIT: [/b]I've finished the SVE compatibility patch! The entrance to the house is just below the sign near the sidewalk. Enjoy and let me know if there are any other issues!

I also havent tested this with the new desert festival, but it should be fine... I think. If there are any issues please let me know, and I'll try to fix them as soon as possible.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[color=#e69138]Requirements:

[/color]Content Patcher
Farm Type Manager

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[color=#e69138]Additional Notes:[/color]

This is my very first major mod, so I apologize if it's a bit scuffed. I've tested it thoroughly for bugs, but if I've missed something please don't hesitate to upload your smapi log and I'll see what I can do! Any feedback or suggestions are also greatly appreciated.

Thank you for visiting my mod! I hope you have a nice day/night.
